from_quote: Congress shall have power to make all laws necessary to carry the Constitution into effect
rationale: The speaker says that "another clause declares that Congress shall have power to make all laws necessary to carry the Constitution into effect"; only the necessary and proper clause fits, and he does not give a number.

from_quote: provide for the common defence and general welfare
rationale: The speaker says the powers of "this clause" include that Congress is "authorized to provide for the common defence and general welfare", words of Article I, Section 8, first paragraph; he does not give a number.

from_quote: to pass all laws necessary for the attainment of those important objects
rationale: In the same sentence the speaker says Congress is authorized "to pass all laws necessary for the attainment of" those objects, describing the last paragraph of Article I, Section 8 without a number.

from_quote: the accounts of the general government are, “from time to time,” to be submitted to the public inspection
rationale: The speaker says the accounts of the government are, "from time to time," to be submitted to public inspection, which describes the statement and account of receipts and expenditures "published from time to time" in Article I, Section 9; he does not name or number it.
